it is expected that you'll see some places, but we need not make every place a whistlestop, 



this will have two effects



1. shorten the flight time
2. give a much more solid sense of place
3. make it easier to understand relative position of things

- Shortens default flight timing.

You’re right—the previous fix only made the waypoint ordering sensible; it still forced the camera through every place coordinate, so the Hermite legs could visibly swing. I’m removing place coordinates from the flight path entirely: the camera will travel on one nearly straight A→B segment, with places used only as nearby label/zoom influences.
